summary.text: Hunter Abell is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 7-Position 2, where he has served since January 2025, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists him as an attorney, a judge of the Ferry County District Court and a U.S. Navy Reserve Commander.

paragraphs.text: Hunter Abell has served in the U.S. Navy Reserve as a Commander and was deployed to Iraq and Guantanamo Bay.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and as a judge of the Ferry County District Court.
He took office in the Washington House on January 13, 2025, succeeding Joel Kretz.
